trait_ArvakTheUnrelenting_Haunted_info: A mysterious entity pursues the marked. The curse can begin manually or through a rare, optional origin.
TestMode: Quick test: guaranteed attempt after 10 s
EnableRandomOrigins Description: Allow a very rare Haunted curse to begin automatically. Off by default; manual application always works.
ChancePerAttemptPercent Description: Probability of an automatic Haunted origin on each scheduled attempt. Ignored in quick test mode.
AttemptIntervalSeconds Description: Real seconds between automatic origin attempts when quick test mode is disabled.
TestMode Description: For testing only: when random origins are enabled, attempt a guaranteed Haunted origin after 10 real seconds if an eligible creature exists. Repeat works when enabled.
RepeatAutomaticOrigins: Repeat random origins after a curse ends
RepeatAutomaticOrigins Description: When enabled, schedule another random origin after all existing Haunted victims are gone. Never starts a second chain while the previous one is active.
